author: Felizia
label: croc4
prompt:
ACTION: the dapper crocodile gentleman from image 1 bends his knees and leaps off the gold mound in a graceful dive with arms forward, and plunges head-first down into a deep pool of gold coins, vanishing under the surface as coins splash upward.
SHOT: wide shot from the side catching the whole arc of the dive, 35mm lens, follows him down.
PLACE: a huge pool of loose gold coins and banknotes below a mound of gold bars, a little golden ladder leaning on the mound.
LIGHT: one warm golden key from above, about 3:1, glittering coins.
SOUND: a soft whoosh of the leap, then a big rich clatter and jingle of coins as he plunges in; no voices, no music.
